request.symptom: 查询突然变慢并偶尔失败，请核对这段时间的证据。

hypotheses.mechanism: JDBC connection pool exhausted (all 4 active, 10 pending) while authentication store was unavailable (CannotGetJdbcConnectionException), causing /api/reports/usage requests to fail with 503 and high latency (avg ~2011ms, 100% error rate in the 14:53:44-45 interval).
